test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the correctly spelt sentence.

options.text: There were two seperte sections of students in my school.
There were two separate sections of students in my school.
There were two sepearte sections of students in my school.
There were two seperate sections of students in my school.

solution:
The correct answer is **option (2).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correctly spelt sentence is **‘There were two separate__ sections of students in my school.”**
 
• **Separate : (अलग)** - Forming or viewed as a unit apart or by itself.
 
• Example: They decided to **separate **their personal life from their professional life for better balance. 
 
• The spelling of **‘SEPARATE’** is incorrect in all other three sentences given in the options.

Therefore, the correct answer is* "There were two **separate** sections of students in my school"*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Read the spellings carefully. These spellings are often asked in the examinations. (Sep**a**rate, Desperate and Deliberate)
 
• **Desperate : (हताश)** - Feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad as to be impossible to deal with.
 
• **Deliberate : (जानबूझकर)** - Done consciously and intentionally.
